  "repair_strategy": "Move the close button element from the modal header to a position after the upload button inside the modal container, preserving its attributes and functionality. This places the close button after the upload button in the DOM tab order, allowing Tab to navigate from upload to close button and then wrap to the first focusable element.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Tabbing within the modal will now follow the sequence: filename → upload → close button → (hidden retry) → wrap to filename. The second Tab press from the upload button will focus the close button, satisfying the requirement that focus stays inside the dialog and wraps correctly.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Visual layout of the close button may change because it is removed from the header flex container that used justify-content: space-between to right‑align it. The button will now appear in the normal flow after the upload button, potentially altering its horizontal placement."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After opening the modal, initial focus is on #filename.",
    "Pressing Tab once moves focus to #upload.",
    "Pressing Tab a second time moves focus to #modal-close.",
    "Pressing Tab a third time moves focus back to #filename (wrapping).",
    "Pressing Escape closes the modal and returns focus to the #open button.",
    "The close button still functions to close the modal when clicked or activated via Enter/Space."
  ]
}
